name: sbom
description: /sbom generates a software bill of materials with every dependency and its license.

format.title: Default format
format.description: What /sbom writes when no format is given: cyclonedx (sbom.cdx.json), spdx (sbom.spdx.json) or md (SBOM.md).

outputDir.title: Output folder
outputDir.description: Folder for the document, relative to the project root; empty for the root itself.

registryLookup.title: Look up unknown licenses online
registryLookup.description: Ask the npm registry, PyPI and crates.io for licenses not found in lockfiles or installed packages (cached).
